title: Raw source
description: Where a founder-supplied source came from, at raw/sources/<id>/source.json (EE-070, EE-192). text.md is the text, written with this record. original.* stays out of git. Raw is immutable. fetched_at, url, archive_of, http_status and self_reported are null when not known. sha256 is the text, written by the router on a new write. A record from before EE-192 may omit the new fields.

origin.description: Where this source came from: a url, a person, or a note such as founder-supplied

fetched_at.description: When it was fetched, with a timezone offset, or null when not known

url.description: The live URL, or null when the source names none

archive_of.description: The live URL this capture archives, or null when it is not an archive

http_status.description: The HTTP status of the fetch, or null when there was none

sha256.description: sha256 of text.md as written, set by the router

self_reported.description: Whether the source is the subject's own account, or null when that is not judged
